subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What public Gateway contract should own per-session activity and attention state across clients?
rationale: The remaining work defines new public RPC/event semantics, attention durability, stale-run recovery behavior, and child-session rollups; those choices affect Gateway protocol compatibility and cannot be safely picked by cleanup automation.

options.title: Keep this canonical and choose the contract
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical design point, review the open candidate PRs against it, and land one coherent Gateway API/event model.

options.title: Adopt a narrower candidate PR
options.body: Sponsor one open PR as the implementation path, but require it to explicitly document which parts of this issue are in or out of scope before closing this issue.

options.title: Defer core API work
options.body: Leave current UI/status projections as partial mitigations and keep richer session activity semantics out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Keep this canonical and choose the contract
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical design point, review the open candidate PRs against it, and land one coherent Gateway API/event model.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is the current issue assignee, so they are the best visible owner for the product/API direction choice even though implementation history is shared.
